headline: Patrol-grade shells built for a lifetime.
body: Our technical outerwear is crafted for serious backcountry skiers who value transparent supply chains and durable materials that last season after season.
rationale: This persona requires explicit craftsmanship and material longevity alongside supply chain transparency rather than generic eco-marketing. It respects their medium price sensitivity by focusing on long-term durability over discounts, while appealing directly to their values.
